what: Tier 3 fine-tune: 50M warm-start steps per clip onto our own video reconstruction.
status: 7 of 10 clips landed; e20 e21 e29 still training
recipe: warm start from each clip's shipped wave-2 actor, cold critic, actor LR x0.1 for 2,000 updates, 299,999,232 -> 349,999,104 steps, seed 42, support per clip, arm-A rewards

registered_bar.status: partial; decided when all ten land

adoption_rule: input-only: the fine-tuned rollout ships only if it has no z-drop and sits closer to the reconstruction it was driven by. No truth is read.
the_rule_validated_itself_here: On these seven the rule adopted e00 e22 e23 e26 and rejected e08 e18 e24. Those are, in truth, the four largest gains (+0.086 +0.165 +0.124 +0.124) and the three it rejected include the only serious loss (e08 -0.307). It turned a raw +0.0296 into +0.0712 without reading truth.
do_not_extend_this_to_the_other_twenty: Pass 1 showed the policy already BEATS its input on the 20 badly-reconstructed clips (0.1787 vs 0.1236). There, 'closer to the input' means closer to a wrong trajectory, so the input-only rule is anti-correlated with truth and would adopt damage. The rule is only safe where the reconstruction is better than the policy, which is exactly the ten clips chosen.
